texts.add.exists: Key “{key}” already exists ({file}, line {line}): edit it in the table.
texts.add.intro: The new key goes in the mod's text file for its area. Write at least one text; the languages you leave empty will show as pending translation.
texts.add.need_text: Write the text in at least one language.
texts.add.target: It will be written to {file} when you save.
texts.add.title: Add a text key
texts.add_key_tooltip: Creates a new key with its texts in the mod file for its area
texts.col.file_tooltip: File and line of the definition the game uses
texts.col.key_tooltip: The key the game's scripts look up
texts.col.lang_tooltip: {language} text (double-click or F2 to edit it)
texts.col.origin_tooltip: Where the text the player will see comes from
texts.degraded_tooltip: Degraded: the mod's CSV replaces the game's and this row has “?” where the game has accented letters.
texts.empty_no_project: Open a mod in Home to see and edit all its texts.
texts.extra_languages_tooltip: Also shows the French and German columns, which the game displays too
texts.hint: Double-click a text or press F2 to edit it; Ctrl+Z undoes it. If the text comes from the base game, it is overridden in the mod's {file}: text.csv is never copied.
texts.loading: Reading the game's and the mod's localisation CSV files in the background…
texts.origin.dependency_tooltip: Defined by a mod your mod depends on
texts.origin.game_tooltip: Defined by the base game: editing it overrides it in a mod file
texts.origin.mod_tooltip: Defined by your mod (or an unsaved change)
texts.origin.override_tooltip: The base game defines it too, but your mod's version wins
texts.search_tooltip: Searches the key and the texts, ignoring case and accents
texts.status_added: Key “{name}” added: it will be written to {file} when you save (Ctrl+Z undoes it).
texts.status_read_only: That text cannot be edited: the project or the file is read-only.
texts.status_unencodable: The character “{char}” ({code}) does not exist in the game's encoding (cp1252): the game could not display it.
texts.status_written: “{name}” will be written to {file} when you save (Ctrl+Z undoes it).
texts.studio_tooltip: It is in one of the mod's Studio text files (00_{prefix}_*.csv).
